series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio run through the endless underground tunnel in the First Phase of the Hunter Exam. A silver-haired boy named Killua joins Gon on a skateboard, sparking an instant friendship and rivalry between the two twelve-year-olds.
Prior events (Part 2): As the underground marathon exceeds eighty kilometers, the oppressive humidity and grueling pace begin breaking the applicants. Tonpa fakes exhaustion to lure others into quitting, while Leorio strips off his suit and pushes his body to the brink of collapse.
